workflow.name: Fix Review Findings
workflow.trigger: fix these, fix findings, address issues, resolve findings, fix what critic found
workflow.description: Address findings from a prior review. User-facing wrapper around remediation.
workflow.precondition: A review_report must exist from a prior Critic step or be provided by the user.

step.goal: Address all critical and high-severity findings from the received review report.
Verify all critical and high findings resolved. Document any remaining issues.
Address remaining critical and high-severity findings.
